text:
incident-bot: PD: P1 - inference-serving: error rate spike across /v1/generate routes (region: us-west) :rotating_light:
alex (oncall): saw this at 16:04, smoke tests show 500s on a subset of hosts. I’m on it.
maya (sre): thanks alex. is PD firing duplicates for the same root cause?
alex (oncall): yes — looks like a burst of ~60 alerts in 2m, many duplicate traces.
sam (runtime): pushing a quick check: backend logs show nvtx OOMs then retries, error 429 from local qcache.
lee (product): any customer-facing impact so far? Support says 3 customers reported slow responses, nothing escalated to security.
alex (oncall): limited impact, top 2 tenants saw degraded p95. Triage -> reduce noisy pages and live-mitigate capacity.
ops-bot: Temporary squelch applied by ops-bot: /squelch --channel eng-oncall --duration 30m --reason "inference OOM burst"
maya (sre): good. plan: (1) apply temporary rate-limit on PD dedupe window (2) add a grouping key on model+route to dedupe similar alerts (3) reduce alert sensitivity for transient spikes and create dashboard for patterndiff.
sam (runtime): I can roll a slow-start config to handlers to backoff retries and lower concurrent in-flight tokens. Will open PR now.
alex (oncall): for PD noise: can we set dedupe window to 5m and rate-limit identical signatures to 1/min? Also create a circuit-breaker so we don't page on >3 repeats within 2m.
maya (sre): yes. I'll create the PD policy change and a short playbook entry. PD policy note: "temporary dedupe: 5m; per-signature rate cap: 1/min; suppression if >40 alerts in 5m"
lee (product): timeline? we should notify customers in-status if we expect 30+ minutes of degraded p95.
sam (runtime): PR for slow-start ready: https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/pull/783 - contains:
```
# config snippet
max_inflight: 50 -> 20
retry_backoff_ms: 100 -> 800
slow_start_window: 60s
```
ready to deploy canary to 2 hosts.
maya (sre): I'll own PD + alert rules update. alex, can you coordinate canary and monitor customer hits?
alex (oncall): on it. starting canary deploy to hosts a,b at 16:12. watching logs + dashboard.
ops-bot: Deploy bot: canary rollout started for runtime v3.2.1 -> hosts a,b.
alex (oncall): after canary looks stable for 6m, we'll roll to remaining pool with slow-start.
maya (sre): filed ticket ENGOPS-1429 to add a dedicated dashboard: "inference-paging-noise" with panels: per-model 5m alert rate, PD dedupe counts, host OOMs. Assign to sam+maya. ETA EOD.
sam (runtime): will also add a short-term prometheus rule tweak:
```
alert: HighTransientErrorRate
expr: increase(inference_errors_total[2m]) > 50
for: 5m
labels:
  severity: warning
```
change to for: 10m during maintenance window.
lee (product): record of decisions: temporary PD squelch 30m, PD dedupe window 5m, per-signature rate cap 1/min, slow-start rollout, dashboard ticket ENGOPS-1429. Notify Support.
alex (oncall): canary healthy at 16:18. reduced retries seem to cut errors by ~70%. Starting gradual rollout.
maya (sre): applying PD policy now and updating runbook.
ops-bot: PD policy updated by maya (sre).
alex (oncall): rolling to remaining hosts. I'll update last_message when rollout completes.
(10m later)
alex (oncall): rollout complete at 16:30. p95 back to normal, PD alerts stopped flaring.
maya (sre): leaving a follow-up item: adjust permanent alert thresholds and add grouping by model+route signature. I'll own post-incident alert tuning doc.
sam (runtime): will follow up with perf tuning PR and quantize recommendations to reduce memory pressure.
lee (product): thanks team. please add summary to the incident tracker and link this thread. Support notified.
alex (oncall): creating post-incident note and adding to #incidents. recommend a 1-week window for observation then permanent PD policy adjustments. :white_check_mark:
